mechanism: Infliximab suppresses TNF-α and immune function, increasing infection risk including tuberculosis reactivation; tranylcypromine is an MAOI with potential to worsen immune suppression and increase CNS/hemodynamic effects in immunocompromised states.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, ensure tuberculosis screening before infliximab initiation, monitor closely for infections, and consider MAOI alternatives with better safety profiles in immunosuppressed patients.
